scope: On-device source geometry, conservative overlap assembly and mandatory uncertainty review. Four paired native original-fifty runs retain rejected trials; final raw/text/financial compatibility is verified. This is not a provider promotion or general receipt-price accuracy gain.

v1.timing_scope: Per-variant image preparation, panel hashing, new worker, OCR, parsing, review gating, source collection and reconciliation. Browser/server/module startup excluded; shared browser asset cache. Metadata and source collection are included only in after, so this measures the full local workflow overhead, not pure model time. No concurrent native benchmark is intended.

trial_findings: v1 retained no source geometry for purchases when a malformed row invalidated an entire panel.

v2 withheld malformed rows locally, but any unmatched text/source slot still invalidated whole-receipt source collection. Aggressive spatial splicing regressed Tesco matched names and one known line price. Reject that assembly.

v3 preserves valid independent source slots. If any matched numeric reading is not literally equivalent, the whole photo retains legacy text assembly and both actual regions. Same-area name differences with an identical literal quantity/unit/total suffix can join; no amount is chosen by confidence or reconciliation.

v4 adds explicit signed-quantity, Unicode-minus and tax-code conflict guards, then repeats the full paired native cohort on the final source. Earlier full browser attempts were interrupted: one overlapped a rebuild, the other exposed a test selector waiting for Edit details on an automatically expanded Hide details row. Preserve both attempts; use the separate final full run after the selector fix.
limitations: English browser OCR remains very inaccurate on this multilingual original corpus. The metadata change improves review, not raw numeric recognition. The stronger local hybrid and prior saved-response provider results are separate measurements.

Source boxes and SDK confidence are not truth or calibrated probabilities. Same-engine overlapping readings are not independent verification. Missing or ambiguous regions remain unhighlighted and pending.

Ground-truth coverage remains partial and source-informed. All fifty complete receipts remain unscorable. Reused original evaluation images are compatibility evidence, not a new blind accuracy study; numeric parsing/recognition rules were not tuned to their labels.
One controlled tall synthetic shows the overlap improvement. Broader genuine-photo overlap, physical-phone memory/camera/timing, Safari and accessibility acceptance remain incomplete.
Per-panel layout/node budgets and worker deadline exist. Worst-case mobile memory and main-thread overlap work have not been profiled.
Historical thirteen artifact gaps remain. Gemini private six-crop approval is pending; no new provider upload occurred. Whole goal remains active.
